question: 看過預覽後，這個數字人試驗（2 次、約 330 積分上限）要怎麼做？

OH-B.action_prompt: 镜头固定特写。她冷静但投入地对着镜头唱歌，嘴随歌词自然张合，乐句之间轻轻换气，肩膀随呼吸微微起伏，头随乐句轻轻点动，眉头舒展，眼神始终看着镜头。
OH-B.why: pure Chinese, positive, actions only (official template: camera + mood + speaking state + actions); 冷静但活着 as the user chose for v3

mode: 即梦 数字人 · 大师模式 · 1080P · single subject (not 生动模式, which crops to 1:1)

budget.rule: the approved bound is about 330 credits for both takes; if the UI price of one take is above 165, stop and ask

scope: new browser automation for the Jimeng 数字人 page (read-only probe first, then the two submits under one-use permits, ledger and continuity report); no other provider, no new account
accept: both phrases visibly open and close
a breath is visible before 'I just'
no frown, no frozen face, no over-acting
